Off Hours in NYC

Off Hours is a New York edibles and vape brand carried at 59 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, with about 640 products on shelves. The line is built around effect-named gummies, with names like Awaken, Euphoric and Dialed, each in a 10-count pack at 10 milligrams per piece, plus a growing set of half-gram all-in-one vapes using the same naming. It is one of the few brands that competes in both categories at scale.

Edibles are the larger part at 455 listings, with 183 vapes. Prices start at $16.50, and most gummy packs sit between $22 and $30 before tax, which puts Off Hours slightly below Camino and Wyld on price. The deepest selection is at Twenty8gramz in Sheepshead Bay with 38 products, followed by ENFLOR in Jackson Heights with 31, and The Daily Green, Sweetlife and Gotham Chelsea with around 21 each. Terp Bros in Astoria is also a strong stop.

Off Hours FAQ
Is Off Hours a New York brand?

Yes. Off Hours products on New York shelves are grown and made in the state, as required for every licensed dispensary. It is one of the larger home-grown edible and vape lines in the market.

What are the Off Hours effect names?

The gummies use names like Awaken, Euphoric and Dialed, and some use minor cannabinoids such as CBG alongside THC. The all-in-one vapes follow the same scheme with names like Dialed and Go. Each pack lists the cannabinoid ratio.

Where is Off Hours cheapest?

In our data the entry price is $16.50, and Twenty8gramz, Gotham Chelsea and Terp Bros list packs starting at $22. Compare the same product across shops on Sensei, since prices vary by store.
